🔥 The fire settles. Yakubu has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A heron that isn't quite there when you look at it — I put it down today." "The heron is gone. No — it's there. It was always there. You just couldn't see it until it moved." "You blink. It is somewhere else. You didn't see it move." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Sari says "Say that again — slower." the man in his 60s, with a shaved head, the crossing guard asks "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
